mode: deep-research quick source verification, not a systematic review
scope: RealHyFC raw approximately 1 Hz direct dynamic-voltage prediction; evidence for one fixed event-weighted MSE experiment and boundaries of future multitask/multiscale suggestions

Output-weighted and relative entropy loss functions 10.1016
Delving into Deep Imbalanced Regression PMLR

selection_criteria.include: Original publisher/proceedings or original author-hosted records with inspectable title, authors, publication date and relevant claims. Only sources inspected through web tools in this optimization round are included.
selection_criteria.exclude: Unverified citations, secondary blog summaries, replacing primary evidence with reviews, duplicate preprint/final-paper counts, transferred numerical RealHyFC performance claims.

semantic_scholar_attempt.method: HTTP GET using PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod, before the primary-site web searches
semantic_scholar_attempt.remaining_batch: Skipped after three consecutive HTTP 429 responses; no Semantic Scholar identities, successful matches or nonmatches are claimed.
semantic_scholar_attempt.fallback: DOI strings and bibliographic identity checked on original publisher/proceedings pages plus actual web search. Several doi.org redirect requests were inaccessible, separately noted per source. No successful resolver status is inferred from a publisher DOI string.

claims.claim_text: Rare-target regression and extreme-event losses motivate testing event emphasis, without proving the present rule or weight optimal.
Multitask balancing and multiple temporal resolutions are published method families, not validated F2 upgrades for this RealHyFC task.
Observed-only inputs must be kept distinct from preavailable future covariates.

negative_constraints: Weights ordinary:event=1:3 are user-preregistered, not established as optimal by the literature.
Event threshold 0.038477648942 V and the prefix event labeling rule are inherited study definitions, not literature-derived physical constants.
Sampling ratio approximately 75:25, 8192 origins, max_epochs=50 and B1/B2 acceptance percentages are user-prespecified engineering choices, not literature optima.
No extra loss weights, new heads, new gates, seeds or architecture search authorized by this bibliography.
No RealHyFC model ranking or numerical improvement asserted without the current actual experiment outputs.

sources.title: Density-based weighting for imbalanced regression
sources.read_this_round: Original publisher HTML, abstract, sections 3.1/3.2, equation 6, discussion and funding metadata
sources.doi_resolution_this_round: doi.org redirect failed with browser HTTP 500; exact DOI/title/author/year match checked on original Springer article
sources.supports: Cost-sensitive regression can weight rare target values through a training-target density estimate. Emphasis on rare outcomes can trade against common-outcome error.
sources.does_not_support: The present prefix-of-horizon event mask, event weight 3, user sampling fractions, F2 superiority or RealHyFC forecast accuracy. DenseLoss equation 6 averages weighted losses using 1/N, not this study's per-batch division by sum of weights.
sources.evidence_design: Controlled computational regression experiments including precipitation; no RealHyFC study
sources.claim_fitness: Direct for considering regression weighting; indirect for this temporal event label
sources.funding_or_coi_observed: Publisher lists Open Access funding enabled and organized by Projekt DEAL. No competing-interests text was found by the performed page search; absence is not an assurance of no conflicts.

coverage_limitations: Targeted quick verification, not an exhaustive or preregistered systematic literature search.
No source used as evidence of an optimal fixed event weight or of results on this RealHyFC experiment.
Original-site identity and claim checks are not Scopus/WoS indexing checks, a full retraction audit, independent experimental replication or exhaustive conflict-of-interest verification.
Some sources were readable through primary-site search excerpts rather than a successful direct full-text open; per-source reading limits are explicit.
No original source files were acquired on disk, so skill trust-chain source_acquired and source_verified_against_original flags intentionally remain false despite primary-web checks.
Preprint and final publication versions count as one source; final publication years used where verified. Older sources are foundational method examples, not claims about the latest best method.
ai_disclosure: AI assisted this targeted search, primary-web source matching and evidence-boundary notes. No human full-reading attestation is claimed. Current study performance decisions require actual experiment artifacts and researcher review.
